en_title: Xbox Offers Doctor’s Note for Undefined Gaming Session Definitely Not Linked to GTA 6
cn_title: XBOX为一场未明确说明的游戏活动提供医生证明，绝对与《GTA6》无关
opus_summary: XBOX推出由DJ Khaled扮演「Dr. XBOX」的宣传活动，玩家可填写姓名，获取建议请假玩游戏的个性化医生证明。活动称本周是「游戏界最盛大的一周」，但未提及《GTA6》。微软还宣布玩家可通过云端游玩《GTA6》，包括使用XBOX One串流，画质设置与XBOX Series S相同。

paragraphs.en: Xbox has kicked off its marketing for the game it’s not allowed to mention in its marketing. Like the weird alligator-shaped Xbox recently announced , Microsoft is doing its best to get Xbox players excited about GTA 6 without saying the game’s name.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX已经开始为一款不能在营销中提及的游戏展开营销。就像最近公布的那台造型古怪的鳄鱼形XBOX一样，微软正竭尽全力在不说出游戏名称的情况下，让XBOX玩家对《GTA6》感到兴奋。

paragraphs.en: “Are you suffering from Vitamin G deficiency?” the new marketing blast asked. “Dr. XBOX has you covered.” I don’t know much about supplements, but there’s a real lack of vitamin G, T, and A over there.
paragraphs.cn: 「你是否正遭受维生素G缺乏症的困扰？」这次新的营销宣传问道。「XBOX医生为你提供帮助。」我对补充剂了解不多，但那里确实缺少维生素G、T和A。

paragraphs.en: For some reason, Dr. Xbox is DJ Khalid, and he wants to get you ready for “the biggest week in gaming.” What makes it the biggest week? No one knows.
paragraphs.cn: 不知为何，XBOX医生是DJ Khalid，他希望让你为「游戏界最重要的一周」做好准备。是什么让这一周成为最重要的一周？没人知道。

paragraphs.en: The website lets you put your name in and get a personalized doctor’s note to play games this week on your Xbox. Obviously DJ Khalid isn’t a medical professional, and there’s no gamer vitamin, so it probably won’t work on your boss, unfortunately.
paragraphs.cn: 该网站允许你输入姓名，获取一份个性化的医生证明，好让你本周在XBOX上玩游戏。显然，DJ Khalid不是医疗专业人士，也不存在什么游戏玩家维生素，所以遗憾的是，这份证明恐怕对你的老板不起作用。

paragraphs.en: “As their physician, mentor, and professional motivator, I am prescribing the patient take some time off to enjoy the biggest week in gaming,” the letter read after I put my details in. “I advise they avoid all meetings, highly stressful jobs, and unnecessary negativity.
paragraphs.cn: 我输入个人信息后，信上写道：「作为患者的医生、导师和专业激励师，我开出的医嘱是让患者休息一段时间，享受游戏界最重要的一周。我建议患者避开所有会议、高压工作和不必要的负面情绪。

paragraphs.en: “Symptoms may include: twitchy thumbs, controller cramps or release-date restlessness.”
paragraphs.cn: 「症状可能包括：拇指抽动、手握控制器导致的痉挛或因发售日期而焦躁不安。」

paragraphs.en: There isn’t a single mention of what makes this the biggest week in gaming. That’s likely because Sony has an exclusive marketing deal with Rockstar to promote the game coming to PlayStation.
paragraphs.cn: 宣传中完全没有提到是什么让这一周成为游戏界最重要的一周。这很可能是因为索尼与Rockstar达成了独家营销协议，宣传这款游戏登陆PlayStation。

paragraphs.en: This has led to some pretty embarrassing misses on Xbox’s part. The first version of the GTA 6 TV spot failed to mention the game coming to Xbox consoles at all.
paragraphs.cn: 这导致XBOX方面出现了一些相当尴尬的遗漏。首版《GTA6》电视广告完全没有提及该游戏将登陆XBOX主机。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft did manage to muscle in a little more recently, with the announcement that you can play GTA 6 on the cloud . This means even people who only own an Xbox One can play GTA 6 if they stream it, which gets them access to the game at Xbox Series S graphics settings.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，微软最近确实设法进一步介入，宣布玩家可以通过云端游玩《GTA6》。这意味着，即使是只拥有XBOX One的人，也能通过串流游玩《GTA6》，以XBOX Series S的画面设置体验游戏。

paragraphs.en: We still don’t know what Xbox Series S graphics settings means, however. Rockstar has said GTA 6 will run at 30fps on all platforms , and PS5 Pro gets some ray tracing upgrades, but there’s no word on what kind of compromises the studio had to make to have the game run on the Xbox Series S. We need a doctor on the case.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，我们仍然不知道XBOX Series S的画面设置意味着什么。Rockstar表示，《GTA6》在所有平台上都将以30fps运行，PS5 Pro还会获得一些光线追踪方面的升级，但工作室为了让游戏在XBOX Series S上运行而不得不做出何种妥协，目前还没有消息。我们需要一位医生来调查此事。
